text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P3 deferred integration milestone. Current header-first ingest and typed catalog exist, while durable preparation, group execution, orchestration and complete resume acceptance remain open dependencies. Credit implemented ingestion/estimate primitives without claiming whole-workflow completion. The original assignment of resume/provenance/pipeline authority to fmri-workflow is subject to the linked ownership RFE; generic scheduler lifecycle is not automatically ScalaFIM scope. Native scientific plans, bounded IO/kernels and local artifact integrity remain reusable core work and are prioritized separately. Replace old manifest assumptions with pinned estimate sets on resumption. This epic explicitly excludes complete HDF5/GDS, whereas its broad output prerequisite now includes HDF5: use the qualified Core-NIfTI milestone as the relevant dependency slice when splitting execution work, without silently waiving core schema/transaction requirements. Preserve exact identity, supported-engine topology, compressed staging and real interrupted-resume/memory proof. No new end-to-end execution or dependency mutation in this assessment.
